naya.title: Superbrain 10/10 Execution Cycle — Naya Note
naya.summary: The Superbrain moved from protocol toward executable enforcement through an authoritative CI gate, duplicate audit, rebuildable relationship graph, deterministic regression tests, retrieval smoke testing, and Daily CIS smoke testing.
lessons: The Superbrain must enforce its laws in code and CI, not merely document them.
Derived relationship graphs must be rebuildable from canonical events.
Green must be observed, not inferred.
next_best_actions: Resolve any failing gate step at root cause.
Then implement safe automated duplicate/entity resolution, contradiction handling, and semantic retrieval benchmarks.

human.title: Superbrain 10/10 Execution Cycle — Shawn Note
human.summary: We are turning the Superbrain from instructions into an executable system that checks itself. The new brain-gate now validates memory, duplicate safety, relationships, retrieval, and Daily CIS before the system can claim success.
lessons: The brain has to prove that it works.
Readable human output and deterministic machine enforcement both matter.
We keep moving forward instead of declaring completion early.
next_best_actions: Get the gate genuinely green, then push the next three highest-value intelligence capabilities.

evidence: Regression suite created and wired into CI.
Relationship graph rebuild created and wired into CI.
Latest Superbrain Gate run is in progress.
